payload.goal: Perform month-end closing for March 2026: accrue prepaid expense, book monthly depreciation, post salary accrual, and verify trial balance balances to zero.
success_checks: Voucher(s) posted with accounting date in March 2026
Prepaid expense reclassification posted: debit expense account and credit 1710 for 14400 NOK
Monthly depreciation posted to account 6030 for 912.50 NOK with balancing credit to accumulated depreciation/fixed asset contra account
Salary accrual posted with debit 5000 and credit 2900 for the same amount
Trial balance for March 2026 is balanced with total debits equal total credits
risk_notes: Expense account for the prepaid cost is not specified; required to complete the 1710 reclassification.
Credit account for depreciation is not specified; typically an accumulated depreciation account is needed.
Amount for salary accrual is not provided; cannot post exact voucher without it.
Need confirmation that March 2026 accounting period is open.
Trial balance check may require all prior March postings to exist in the sandbox.
payload.suggested_first_action: Fetch or confirm chart of accounts and identify the target expense account for the 1710 periodization, depreciation credit account, and salary accrual amount before creating vouchers.

line_items.description: Monthly prepaid expense periodization from account 1710 to expense account for March 2026
Monthly linear depreciation for fixed asset cost 109500 over 10 years to account 6030
Salary accrual for March 2026: debit 5000, credit 2900

ordered_steps: Check accounting period/status for March 2026 via accounting periods endpoint.
Fetch chart of accounts and confirm target expense account for prepaid cost reclassification from 1710.
Create voucher dated 2026-03-31 for prepaid expense periodization: credit 1710 by 14400 and debit specified expense account by 14400.
Fetch chart of accounts and confirm depreciation credit account (typically accumulated depreciation/fixed asset contra account).
Create voucher dated 2026-03-31 for depreciation: debit 6030 by 912.50 and credit confirmed depreciation balance account by 912.50.
Obtain salary accrual amount for March 2026.
Create voucher dated 2026-03-31 for salary accrual: debit 5000 and credit 2900 for the confirmed amount.
Fetch trial balance for March 2026 and verify total debits equal total credits.
If imbalance exists, inspect posted vouchers and correct before finalizing month-end.

planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.
Create a new free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimension
Create a new value for one of the free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimensions

rules: ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.

When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting with the GROSS amount (incl VAT). Tripletex auto-generates VAT split and credit posting. If this fails with a balance error, fall back to manual postings for all legs.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.
